      Where the data comes from

      Goals, locations, goalies and strength come from the NHL's play-by-play feed, checked against the official game reports. Expected goals (xG) and shot attempts are from MoneyPuck, 2007-08 on. Tracking replays are NHL EDGE puck and player tracking, 2023-24 on.

      How the map works

      The rink is the offensive half with the net at the top, so the left faceoff circle is on the left, as Ovechkin sees it. Locations are the scorer's spot as logged by the NHL. Empty-net goals shot from his own end sit along the bottom edge. Shootout goals are not included.

      Fan-made

      Not affiliated with the NHL, the Washington Capitals or MoneyPuck. Totals run through Nov 1, 2026.
